title: NetworkUserReport
description: network.user-report@1 (ask 287): one report a person filed about another person on OpenVibe.Network. Reports never resolve themselves; staff holding staff.moderation.logs read the queue (GET /api/v1/staff/user-reports?status=open&target=usr_…&limit=), and a staff decision lives in the moderation audit log. `status` records whether staff have looked, not a verdict.
